zh: 下幽冥的前一夜。月光還在，每一個人，都多看了它一眼。
洛無塵，要是明天回不來，你欠我的那一戰……
這一次，沒有算。這一次，是相信。
老和尚，明天要是死在下面，貧道這壺酒，你喝不喝？
阿彌陀佛。活著回來，老衲陪你喝茶。
孤鴻，你從來不說話。你怕嗎？
……他指的是洛先生。他說，跟著那個人，就不怕。
可是你們都去了，我一個人留在上面，更可怕。
幽冥魔域。沒有日，沒有月，只有地底的火，照著一群從人間來的人。
洛無塵說：這一次，不演戲，不算計。
因為你說過，這是你這輩子，賺得最值的一百兩。
洛無塵，你帶著他們來送死，這一步棋，你算過嗎？
算過。算到最後，這一局，無塵不用算。
因為跟無塵一起來的，都是不會回頭的人。
那就讓本帝看看，人心，能不能擋住幽冥。
啞劍，你砍了兩個，我也砍了兩個。平手！
凌雲霄！三次了。這一次，我們之間，只能活一個！
這一次……本尊……真的……回不來了……
月下的那一劍，今天，終於結束了。
月清寒，本王一直想要一張新的臉。今天，就要妳的。
十年前，你要了我的心。今天，你什麼都拿不走了。
千面之下……原來……本王的真臉……是這個樣子……
一個魔尊，一個鏡王。你們殺得很好。
可是，天機策，已經合一了。
一把狂刀，一把啞劍。可惜，都太輕了。
就這樣？三教之力，就只有這樣？
陰陽郎君。你也來看本帝，打開人間的門？
本來是。可是看了一會兒，本郎君發現——
看他們輸，不好玩。看你輸，才好玩！
阿彌陀佛。帝君，人心會碎，可碎了的人心，還會再長回來。
幽冥之門，在萬劍與一池蓮光之中，緩緩地合上了。
太虛峰。雲海之上，太陽，又一次升了起來。
天機策。兩卷，都在這裡了。
你真的要燒？算盡天下每一步棋的書，你捨得？
天機不可盡知。人心，方是天機。
洛無塵。現在，總可以真的打一場了吧？
凌大俠，以後……你還守著我嗎？
在錢兄的袖子裡。從無塵落水那天起，就在了。
洛先生，鏡湖的月亮，以後，就只是月亮了。
那就好。月亮，本來就只該是月亮。
戲演完了，本郎君也該走了。
郎君下一場，要去看什麼？
下一場？哈哈……你們很快就會知道。
天機策化成了灰，飄進了雲海。
只是，沒有人知道，殷九霄去了哪裡。
蓮心小築。一池蓮花，又變回了白色。
上一次，無塵斟了兩杯，一杯給自己，一杯給要殺我的人。
這一次，兩杯茶，都有人喝了。
一蓮開時天下靜，半笑之間局已成。江湖，再會。
en: The night before they went down into the Netherworld. The moonlight was still there, and every one of them looked at it a moment longer.
Luo Wuchen, if we don’t come back tomorrow — the fight you owe me...
Have you worked that out too?
This time I worked out nothing. This time, I believe.
I am. But you are here.
Old monk, if we die down there tomorrow — will you drink this wine of mine?
Amitabha. Come back alive, and I will drink tea with you.
Gu Hong, you never speak. Are you afraid?
...He is pointing at Master Luo. He means: following that man, he is not afraid.
I’m afraid! I’m scared to death! But...
But if you all go, being left up here alone would be even scarier.
The Netherworld. No sun, no moon — only the fire under the ground, lighting a band of people come down from the world of men.
Luo Wuchen had said: this time, no acting, no scheming.
Why... why did I have to come too...
Because you said it was the best hundred taels you ever earned.
The heroes of the world of men have all arrived.
Luo Wuchen, you have brought them here to die. Did you reckon out this move?
I did. And in the end, this game is one Wuchen does not need to reckon.
Because everyone who came with Wuchen is the kind who does not turn back.
Then let me see whether men’s hearts can hold back the Netherworld.
Mute Sword — you cut down two, so did I. A draw!
Ling Yunxiao! Three times now. This time, only one of us lives!
This time... I... truly... cannot come back...
The sword under the moon has finally come to its end today.
Yue Qinghan. This king has long wanted a new face. Today, I will have yours.
Ten years ago you took my heart. Today, you will take nothing more.
Nine Folds of the Cold Moon!
Mirror Light of Ten Thousand Forms!
Nine Folds — of the Cold Moon!
Beneath a thousand faces... so this... is what this king’s true face looks like...
...I forgot your true face long ago.
A demon lord, a mirror king. You have killed well.
But the Stratagem is already whole.
A mad blade and a mute sword. A pity — both far too light.
Lotus Sword Light: Three Thousand Worlds!
Is that all? The power of the Three Teachings — only this?
Men’s hearts? Men’s hearts break more easily than anything.
Ha... ha ha ha ha ha!
The Yin-Yang Gentleman. Have you come too, to watch me open the gate of the world?
I had. But after watching a while, I realised —
watching them lose is no fun at all. Watching YOU lose — that will be fun!
Amitabha. Emperor — men’s hearts do break. But broken hearts grow back again.
Amid ten thousand swords and a pond’s worth of lotus light, the gate of the Netherworld slowly closed.
Void Peak. Above the sea of clouds, the sun rose once again.
The Celestial Stratagem. Both halves, here.
You really mean to burn it? A book that foresees every move under heaven — you can bear to?
Heaven’s design cannot be wholly known. Men’s hearts — those are heaven’s design.
Luo Wuchen. Now, at last, we can have a real fight?
Then we save it for next time.
Master Ling... will you still keep me safe, from now on?
From now on, you keep me safe.
Is in your sleeve, Brother Qian. It has been since the day Wuchen went into the water.
Master Luo, from now on, the moon over the Mirror Lake is only a moon.
Good. A moon should only ever have been a moon.
The show is over. Time I was off.
And what will the Gentleman go to watch next?
Next? Ha ha... you’ll find out soon enough.
The Stratagem turned to ash, and drifted down into the sea of clouds.
Only, no one knew where Yin Jiuxiao had gone.
The Lotus Heart Retreat. The pond of lotus had turned white again.
Last time, Wuchen poured two cups: one for himself, one for the man who came to kill him.
This time, both cups have someone to drink them.
When the lotus opens, all under heaven is still; between half a smile and the next, the game is won. Until we meet again.
